name: agentic-sdlc
description: Agentic Software Development Lifecycle — end-to-end AI-driven workflow from idea to platform-ready issues. Covers requirement grilling, PRD writing, project constitution (with DDD bounded-context mapping, tiered branch/promotion CI models, and scoped amendment of an existing constitution), feature decomposition, TDD test planning, UI design elicitation and mockup generation, issue structuring, PMS delivery, domain-parallel agentic implementation (Ralph), bug reporting, brownfield repo agent-readiness triage (deterministic scoring across git/build/test/CI/deps/debt/structure signals, gated verdicts, and pilot-zone recommendations for portfolios of undocumented legacy repos), brownfield codebase mapping (real dependency-graph extraction via Graphify, module/hub/hidden-coupling synthesis, and zone coupling refresh), brownfield constitution discovery (reverse-engineering ai-context/ files from measured repo facts instead of an interview, with legacy risk areas flagged as seam candidates for the characterization-and-seams phases that follow), and per-zone context drill-down (one ai-context/zones/ file per candidate pilot zone with the specific modules, hubs, hidden coupling, and cycles that actually touch it).
